texts.preamble: Devyani International Limited & Others vs State Of Uttarakhand & Another on 25 March, 2015 Author: U. C. Dhyani Bench: U. C. Dhyani Wpcrl No.342 of 2015 Hon'ble U. C. Dhyani, J. Mr. Chetan Joshi, Advocate present for the petitioners. Mr. Raman Kumar Sah, Deputy Advocate General with Mr. Kuldeep Singh Rawal, Brief Holder present for the State.
texts.arguments: The principal submission of learned counsel for the petitioners is that the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal has not been constituted in the State as yet and therefore, the petitioner cannot challenge the impugned order of the adjudicating Officer before the said Tribunal.
texts.petitioner_arguments: The principal submission of learned counsel for the petitioners is that the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal has not been constituted in the State as yet and therefore, the petitioner cannot challenge the impugned order of the adjudicating Officer before the said Tribunal.
